title: Sampled Fourier coefficient
statement: Given $s\in\mathbb N$, a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, samples $S_i\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ for $i=1,\ldots,s$, and a subset $T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, define the sampled coefficient at $T$ to be $\|\widehat f\|_1/s$ times the sum of $\operatorname{sgn}(\widehat f(T))$ over sample indices $i$ for which $S_i=T$.
